packageRules.description: release.yaml must reference the moving releasetools/mutex@v1 tag so it verifies the release that was just published. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests pinned it in #43 and re-pinned it in #63; because the digest bump only lands after a release, a pin is always one release stale at the moment the release workflow runs.

customManagers.description: The Claude Code and Codex CLI versions the release pins to validate and install the agent plugin. They are not dependencies of anything, so no manager sees them without being told.
